CHAPTER 1:
The King of Hell has been Hexecuted, leaving the fate of Heaven, Hell, and The Universe on the shoulders of a washed up chef named Lewi. Troubled by his own inner demons and armed with his culinary skills, does Lewi have what it takes to save everyone? And everything?

CHAPTER 2:
With the contract signed, Lewi must follow through and fulfill his duty as head chef of the shrine that holds Hell’s fate in the balance. With the support of the groundskeeper, Elsi, and his “surreal estate agent”, Bea, Lewi won’t have to face these ordeals on his own. Especially as Leova, the vengeful daughter of The Kingdom of Haven, has her sights set on disrupting the powers that be and bring Hell to the brink of destruction.
